## Objective
- Build a playable 3D pixelated RPG with knight-focused progression, classes, loot rarities, regional bosses, property management, and a path to kingship.
- Reduce on-screen text and add on-screen menu buttons.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Make it be 3D not 2D”.

## Decisions
- Game is implemented as a standalone `index.html` with no external assets.
- Earlier version used a 2D canvas scene; a partial change to initialize WebGL has been started, but the game is not yet rendered in 3D.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the RPG UI and gameplay systems in `index.html`: classes, combat, leveling, skill tree, loot rarities, properties, regions, bosses, and kingship.
- Added icon buttons to the scene controls for attack, interact, skills, pack, holdings, and map.
- Reduced several UI text labels.

### Active
- Convert the scene renderer from 2D canvas drawing to actual 3D WebGL rendering; the latest change only replaces the 2D canvas context initialization with a WebGL context.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was attempted but Chromium was unavailable: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`

## Next Move
1. Complete WebGL 3D scene rendering and adapt pixel-art scenery, knight, enemies, and movement to the 3D scene.
2. Remove remaining explanatory text and ensure each menu is accessible with on-screen buttons.
3. Validate JavaScript and test the game in a browser if Chromium becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the entire game; latest incomplete WebGL renderer change is here.

## Important Context
- `index.html` currently initializes `gl` with WebGL, but the old renderer still uses `ctx` and 2D canvas drawing, so the page will fail until the renderer is replaced.

- Build a playable 3D pixel-art RPG centered on knight progression, regional bosses, loot, property management, and kingship.
- Add merchants and quests, make kingship very difficult to achieve, and add level-based enemies and zones.

## Requirements
- The game should be 3D, not 2D.
- Reduce on-screen text and provide on-screen menu buttons.
- Add merchants and quests; make kingship hard to attain; have enemies and zones scale by level.

## Decisions
- The game is a standalone `index.html` with no external assets.
- The scene is being rendered with custom WebGL low-poly geometry rather than a 2D canvas.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing RPG systems include classes, combat, leveling, skills, loot rarities, properties, regions, bosses, and kingship.
- Added on-screen icon controls for attack, interaction, skills, pack, holdings, and map.
- Replaced the old 2D scene renderer with a custom WebGL renderer featuring 3D terrain, scenery, player, and enemy models.

### Active
- Add merchants and quests.
- Rebalance progression: substantially harder kingship, with level-gated zones and enemies.
- Verify and refine the current 3D rendering and gameplay.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was previously blocked because Chromium was unavailable: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`

## Next Move
1. Inspect and validate the WebGL renderer in `index.html`; fix any runtime or visual issues.
2. Implement merchant access and purchases, plus quest objectives, progress, and rewards.
3. Set clear level ranges and entry requirements for zones; scale enemy levels and stats to each zone.
4. Increase the difficulty and requirements for claiming kingship, then validate gameplay and JavaScript.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game, including UI, gameplay systems, and current WebGL renderer.

## Important Context
- The renderer replacement was applied to `index.html`; the attempted earlier edit failed, but a later script successfully replaced the old renderer section.
- Current region data lists level ranges, but enemy levels are currently based mainly on player level and region offsets.
- Current kingship logic is comparatively simple: Highcourt and the throne use a 100-renown threshold.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 3D pixel-art RPG in `index.html` centered on knight progression, regional bosses, loot, property management, and kingship.
- Add merchants, quests, level-scaled enemies and zones, and make becoming king difficult.

## Requirements
- The game should be 3D, not 2D.
- Reduce on-screen text and provide on-screen menu buttons.
- Add merchants and quests; make kingship hard to attain; have enemies and zones scale by level.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a standalone `index.html` with no external assets.
- Use custom WebGL low-poly geometry for the 3D scene.
- Gate regions by level and prior guardian victories; require substantial progression to claim the crown.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added icon controls for combat, interaction, skills, pack, holdings, map, merchant, and quests.
- Implemented custom WebGL 3D terrain, scenery, player, and enemy models.
- Added level-scaled enemies and region ranges, plus traveling merchant stock gated by player level.
- Added three tracked quests with claimable gold and renown rewards.
- Raised kingship requirements to level 10, all three guardians defeated, 250 renown, a Stone Keep, and all quests claimed.
- Updated guardian quest progress and unlocks; added region-specific entry requirements and lock indicators.
- Updated king progress meter and combat hint to show the revised requirements and enemy level.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript syntax and game systems; check region/map messaging and fix any runtime, progression, or UI inconsistencies.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was previously blocked because Chromium was unavailable: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`

## Next Move
1. Check JavaScript syntax and determine whether browser tooling is available.
2. Review map/region descriptions and lock messaging against `regionRequirement()` and kingship requirements.
3. Test combat, quest completion and rewards, merchant purchases, property ownership, and kingship; fix progression bugs.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game, including UI, gameplay systems, quests, merchant, region gates, and WebGL renderer.

## Important Context
- Highcourt entry requires level 10, all three guardians defeated, and 180 renown.
- Claiming kingship additionally requires 250 renown, a Stone Keep, and all quests claimed.
- Browser-based verification has not been confirmed after the latest edits.
